notes.title: Spacebar sequel coming this month!
notes.content: [p]Hello![/p][p]We are currently finishing up a sequel to Spacebar called [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3938670/Spacebar_X/"]Spacebar X[/url], set to release this month![/p][p]The main differences are that jump is now combined with flip and fly, offering unique patterns that can make use of the combined mechanics. There will also be a new warp mechanic that allows you to teleport to an indicator on the screen.[/p][p]If you enjoyed Spacebar, be sure to wishlist Spacebar X so you will be notified of the release![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="70Mqf6Voh0g;full"][/previewyoutube]
